comments.author: Ib
comments.body:
"Nationality" merchant fleet in Carabean and SEA sea. seize cargo. Those fleets need to be triggered to spawn by killing other ships .
Dutch near Makassar (trigger)
English west of Dili (trigger)
Portugese south of Surybaya (trigger)
Venitian south of St-Lucia (trigger)
French east of cayenne (trigger)
Spanish west carabean (trigger)
